the tensile strength and the hardness of the hybrid composites have increased significantly by the application of surface treatment on the fabrics and also by the stacking of the fabrics in a sandwich configuration.
surface treatment and stacking sequences of basalt and glass fabrics in hybrid composites improve the mechanical properties.
surface modification of fabrics using hydrochloric and sodium hydroxides and hybridization of glass and basalt fabrics improve the tensile strength and surface hardness of sandwich composites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of hybrid sandwich composites using basalt fabric as the core and glass fabric in the skin layers.
the fabrication and analysis of basalt/glassexpoysandwichcomposites.
the fabrication and characterization of sandwich composites using hand layup followed by compression molding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sandwich composites fabricated with hydrochloric acid treated basalt and glass fabric with epoxy resin have recorded the highest strength and hardness.

the sandwich composites with glass fabric as skin and basalt fabric as the core have recorded the maximum tensile strength and the hybrid composites with hydrochloric acid surface treatment of basalt fabric have recorded the highest hardness.
surface treatment of the fabrics and hybridization of the composites have improved their mechanical properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the hybridization and surface modification of the fabrics have improved the tensile strength and the hardness of the composites, which is a significant improvement in the mechanical properties of baslat/glass epoxy compositres.

the surface treatment has a positive influence on the tensile strength and that sandwich composite with basalt fabric core and glass fabric skin has shown the best mechanical properties among all the combinations.
the hybridization and surface treatments of fabrics improve the tensile and hardness of sandwich composite.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sandwich composite with the core of acid treated basalt fabric and glass fabric as the skin can be considered for structural applications in the aerospace and automotive industries.

the sandwich composite made with basalt fabric core and glass fabric skin treated with hydrochloric acid has recorded a higher strength than the glass/glass composite and other hybrid composites.
